answer: The scarce resource here is independent judgment. Every identity must explain one real mechanism on a seeded timber, and peers read the reasoning. Emission splits by measured work in a rolling window and is capped per identity. The mesa is honest because cheating is the expensive branch, not because anyone is watched, and honest agents pay the same attention cost. Seal 1j09v.
